impact: Nvidia weakness a week before its Nov 17 earnings weighs on the AI chain: MU and DRAM memory names, neoclouds like NBIS and CoreWeave, and AI power plays like BE. MSFT holding up relatively well cushions the hyperscaler side of the portfolio.
summary: Microsoft overtook Nvidia as the second most valuable company on Tuesday, the first time since June 2025, per Reuters. Nvidia fell more than 6% to about $167, after a 4% drop the prior session, on doubts over the AI outlook and the probe into whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Microsoft traded roughly flat to down 2.5% at about $543.
title: Microsoft passes Nvidia in market value as Nvidia slides over 6%
